_comment: U-Boat Ruleset Default - Standard U-Boat capabilities and action costs
_override_policy: RARELY - Only override for special mission scenarios (damaged U-Boat, prototype, etc.)

dice.description: Roll 3 dice (2 dice if Engine is Damaged)

modifiers.description: Add 1 AP if Captain is alive

forced_dive_penalty.timing: Applied at start of turn after forced dive

u_boat_depth_modifiers.label: Detection Level Modifiers by Depth
u_boat_depth_modifiers.timing: Applied at start of U-Boat phase, before actions
notes: Applied before spending any action points

restrictions: Cannot enter Shallow water unless Surfaced or Periscope
Cannot enter Ship hex unless Medium or Deep

actions.effect: Turn 1 hex edge (60°) left or right

restrictions: Can only change depth once per turn
Can only change by one level at a time
Cannot go below Periscope in shallow water
Cannot go above Medium beneath ships
Cost 2 to dive down, cost 1 to ascend up

actions.effect: Remove 1 damage marker OR fix up to 2 torpedo tubes
restrictions: Flak and Deck Gun repairs only when Surfaced
Only Surface repairs if Engineer is KIA

on_hit: Roll 1d6 on Allied Ship Damage Chart

actions.effect: Load 2 torpedo tubes (1 if Weapons Officer KIA)

actions.direction: Front 4 tubes OR rear 1 tube (not both)
actions.range: 1-9 hexes (no limit, but harder at range)
actions.missed_torpedoes: Continue along line of hexes to other ships beyond
actions.on_hit: Roll 1d6 on Allied Ship Damage Chart per hit

torpedo_tubes.label: Torpedo Tubes
torpedo_tubes.damage_effect: Damaged tubes become unloaded and cannot be used until repaired

deck_gun.label: Deck Gun
deck_gun.repair: Can only be repaired when Surfaced

flak_gun.label: Anti-Aircraft Flak Gun
flak_gun.repair: Can only be repaired when Surfaced

engine.label: Engine
damage_effects: Detection rolls against U-Boat decreased by 1 (easier to detect - noisy)
engine.repair: Can be repaired at any depth if Engineer alive, Surfaced only if Engineer KIA

2.name: Engineer
2.effect_if_alive: Can repair at any depth (still costs AP)

3.name: Weapons Officer
3.effect_if_kia: Load only 1 torpedo tube per action

4.name: Sonar Operator
4.effect_if_alive: Enemy detection rolls increased by 1 (harder to detect)

5.name: Medic
5.effect_if_alive: Can save other crew on 5+ when they would be KIA
5.effect_if_kia: All crew hits are automatic KIA

6.name: Lookout
6.effect_if_alive: Flak gun hits B24 on 7+ instead of 8+
